title: Project defense: explain decisions and make an independent change
goal: Present reproducible applied work, answer from your data and finish assessment with honest boundaries.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 7; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: A defense explains decisions
paragraphs: Show model, workflows, checks and recovery rather than reciting definitions. Explain field types, references versus names and rejected-write behavior. Review questions concern the actual deliverable. A local system may preserve answers as self-report but cannot call that an independent defense.

Defend your actual infobase: locate customer/service/request/filter, justify types and explain rejection. Trace one report row back to documents. Definitions without your own demonstration are insufficient. Prepare a 5–7-minute presentation and an artifact list.

sections.title: Explanation and transfer
paragraphs: Use your own installed 1C result and independent controls.

sections.title: A transfer change checks understanding
paragraphs: Add a filter or report variant for another period. Predict the result, create a copy and change it without a solved walkthrough. Then repeat prior workflows. Explaining the consequences of a changed condition demonstrates understanding better than replaying a memorized click sequence.

Make a control change in another copy: a different customer filter, a valid extra document or an optional field. Predict before acting and repeat old cases afterward. Retain the pre-defense version, changed copy and answers rather than replaying one memorized route.

sections.title: Transition to P is optional
paragraphs: An applied graduate operates the system and performs foundational configuration within scope. Professional P adds algorithms, modules, queries and engineering verification. Shared concepts help, but A completion does not automatically complete P topics. Transition creates a new work copy with provenance rather than transferring unrelated competency credit.

Open this direction’s Nexus final assessment and complete your theory variant, four practical tasks and selected project rubric. Keep actual files/DT separately: links/self-reports do not upload or automatically verify execution. Retain previous attempts.

sections.title: Marks instead of work
paragraphs: Preserve the source and record the actual limitation.

sections.title: The final package remains learner work
paragraphs: Preserve the pre-defense version, changed copy, answers and transfer-check results. Do not erase attempts to beautify the record. Declare templates and assistance without claiming unverified independent authorship. Instructor grading and certification belong to a separate process that local self-checking does not replace.

Programming is an optional next direction. Shared knowledge helps but A completion does not mark P topics complete. State templates and Akronikl/other assistance as provenance. Teacher certification/authorship verification requires a separate process, not an imitation by the local candidate.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: Topic completion is mistaken for a verified practical capstone. Demonstrate actual records, independent checks and recovery separately.
The accepted source is overwritten during a control change. Create a separately named copy and preserve its provenance and old work.
A local self-report is presented as teacher certification. Record the actual grading boundary, evidence and any assistance.
